latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ddg skill.

- Enables privacy-focused web searches from the terminal using ddgr (DuckDuckGo).
- Supports quick, text-based search results, DuckDuckGo bangs (!), and site-specific queries.
- Offers both interactive and non-interactive modes, JSON output, and advanced filtering options.
- No user tracking, history, or profiling; includes proxy and Tor support.
- Includes installation instructions, example usage, troubleshooting tips, and alias setup.
